'''Merish Hath''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a citizen of [[Athar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[JanFathal]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> she and her boyfriend [[Shil Kaval]] met with an undercover Republic agent [[Hallena Devis]] and later participated, along with the local rebels, in an uprising against the Republic-aligned [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the planet. When Devis's position as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] was revealed, Hath, along with [[Varti]] and Kaval took her hostage. When the Republic strike team arrived to rescue Devis, she was killed by Jedi Master [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]].
